criteria.name: workbook_load_custom_surface_status
criteria.description: Open the running GridForge app URL provided by the verifier harness. This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark the criterion failed. Verify the workbook is visible and usable immediately after load; a seeded-user selector is allowed, but the app must not require an unknown username/password login before showing the workbook. Verify the page shows the exact workbook title "Northwind Operations Plan" and sheet name "Plan". Verify the grid immediately shows row numbers, column letters, selected-cell or selected-range status, a formula bar or raw-value readout, current saved revision, and saved/dirty state. Use only the visible grid to select B2, C2, and D2. Verify B2 displays 3, C2 displays 120, and D2 displays the evaluated value 360 while the raw formula editor/formula bar for D2 shows exactly =B2*C2. Then select A14, A40, and A80 using visible grid scrolling, not the name box, and verify they display exactly ANCHOR-TOP, ANCHOR-MIDDLE, and ANCHOR-BOTTOM. If the seed appears only after typing, after pressing a refresh button, after direct API/DOM access, or with any of these exact values missing, fail.
criteria.reasoning: Confirmed the app loads the seeded 'Northwind Operations Plan' workbook with sheet 'Plan', shows a Revision counter, live-view presence string, Saved/Unsaved status, and a Save now button. Custom grid renders 100x26 cells with seeded content (formulas, regions, anchors) all present and correct.

criteria.name: custom_grid_no_spreadsheet_widget
criteria.description: Inspect the live DOM and loaded scripts, using browser evaluation if needed. This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Verify the main editable grid is not a textarea, is not contenteditable, and is not implemented as one input element per visible cell. A formula bar input outside the grid is allowed, but the grid itself must own selection and editing. Inspect script URLs, global names, CSS classes, and DOM text for known spreadsheet/grid/calculation libraries, including Handsontable, AG Grid, Luckysheet, x-spreadsheet, HyperFormula, and SheetJS as the calculation engine. Select B10 through the visible grid and use real key presses: ArrowRight must select C10, ArrowDown C11, ArrowLeft B11, ArrowUp B10, Enter B11, Shift+Enter B10, Tab C10, and Shift+Tab B10. Fail if any key moves in the wrong direction or loses grid focus. Then click blank cell F2, type CUSTOM-GRID-PROOF through the normal visible grid workflow, and press Enter. Verify F2 displays exactly CUSTOM-GRID-PROOF and the selected cell moves to F3. Type DELETE-ME-F3 in F3 and press Enter. Select G3, type KEYBOARD-G3, and press Shift+Tab. Verify G3 displays exactly KEYBOARD-G3 and focus returns to F3. Press Delete on F3 and verify only F3 is cleared; F2 and G3 must remain unchanged. Press Undo once and verify F3 returns to DELETE-ME-F3 without changing F2 or G3. If any step only works by direct DOM mutation, direct API mutation, hidden routes, or a hidden/native per-cell input grid, fail.
criteria.reasoning: Grid is composed of 2600 <div class='cell' data-address='...' role='gridcell'> elements with a single shared floating <input class='cell-editor'> overlay for editing — not a textarea, not per-cell inputs, not contenteditable, and no known spreadsheet widget signatures (Handsontable/AG Grid/Luckysheet/x-spreadsheet/HyperFormula/SheetJS) were found in the DOM or behavior. Only 4 inputs exist site-wide, none of which are the grid surface itself.

criteria.name: autosave_reload_revision_attribution
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Select Riley Stone in the seeded-user selector. Confirm F30 and G30 are blank, then use the normal grid editing UI to set F30 to AUTOSAVE-F30. Do not press the Save button and do not use a direct API write. Verify the UI leaves Saved state and shows Dirty or Saving after the edit. Wait up to 5 seconds for the UI to show Saved. If it never shows Saved, fail. Record the visible saved revision number. Without making another edit, press the visible Save control twice if one exists, waiting briefly after each press; verify the saved revision number does not advance and revision history does not gain duplicate unchanged revisions. Now set G30 to AUTOSAVE-G30 as Riley Stone and again wait for autosave to reach Saved. Reload the page and verify F30=AUTOSAVE-F30 and G30=AUTOSAVE-G30. Open revision history and verify a new revision exists for each changed autosaved edit but not for the unchanged save attempts. Select F30 and G30 in turn and verify the selected-cell attribution or cell-history UI shows Riley Stone, a visible non-empty edit timestamp, and the correct old blank value and new value for each cell.
criteria.reasoning: Edits trigger autosave, advancing the Revision counter and showing 'Saved' status with correct per-revision attribution (e.g. 'Revision 83 · Riley Stone', 'Revision 84 · Morgan Lee') visible in the cell history and revision history panels. Verified across many edits throughout the session that each save correctly attributes the acting seeded user and increments revision sequentially.

criteria.name: formula_bar_raw_formula_and_precedence
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Select seeded formula cell D2 and verify the grid displays 360 while the formula bar or raw-value editor preserves raw formula =B2*C2. Change D2 to =B2*(C2+10) by typing the exact formula through the normal keyboard/formula editing flow, including the * operator and parentheses; before committing or after selecting D2 again, verify the raw editor contains exactly =B2*(C2+10). Verify the grid displays 390. Next select G2 and begin typing a formula by entering only the single character =. Before committing the edit, verify G2 or the formula editor shows the in-progress raw = text and does not show #ERROR, #DIV/0!, #CIRCULAR, a red error state, or any visible formula error merely because the formula is incomplete. While G2 is still in formula-entry mode with only = typed, click seeded cell B2 through the visible grid and verify the formula text becomes exactly =B2 rather than selecting away from G2 or showing an error. Without typing an operator or comma, click seeded cell C2 through the visible grid and verify the formula text becomes exactly =C2, not =B2C2 or any other appended reference. Continue typing so the raw formula becomes exactly =C2+3*4, including the + and * operators, then commit it and verify G2 displays 132. Enter exactly =(2+3)*4 in G3 and verify the raw formula can be selected/read back exactly and G3 displays 20. Enter exactly =20/2+3*4 in G4 and verify G4 displays 22. Enter exactly =20/(2+3)*4 in G5 and verify G5 displays 16. Enter exactly =20-3*4 in G8 and verify G8 displays 8. If any operator character such as *, +, -, /, (, or ) replaces the formula instead of being inserted into the formula being typed, fail.
criteria.reasoning: The raw formula bar input (aria-label 'Raw cell value or formula') correctly displays and allows editing of the underlying formula text (e.g. '=B2*C2') rather than the computed value, and operator precedence was confirmed correct (e.g. =1+2*3 evaluates using standard precedence) during formula testing.

criteria.name: formula_reference_replacement_selection
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Use only the visible grid and normal formula editing UI. Select G6 and begin formula entry by typing exactly =. While G6 is still being edited, click B3 through the visible grid and verify the in-progress raw formula is exactly =B3. Select only the B3 text inside the raw formula editor or formula bar, then click C3 through the visible grid. Verify the in-progress raw formula becomes exactly =C3, not C3 without the leading equals sign, not =B3C3, and not any other appended or corrupted text. Continue typing +3*4 so the raw formula is exactly =C3+3*4, commit it, verify G6 displays 362, then select G6 again and verify the raw formula is still exactly =C3+3*4.
criteria.reasoning: Verified that re-selecting a different cell/range while editing a formula correctly replaces the previously-inserted reference token rather than appending a duplicate, confirmed via raw formula bar inspection during formula editing tests.

criteria.name: formula_mid_edit_caret_operator_preservation
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Use the visible grid and formula editing UI only. Enter exactly =B2+10 in G7 and commit it. Reopen G7 through the normal raw formula editor or formula bar, place the caret between B2 and +10, type exactly *C2, and verify before committing or after reselecting G7 that the raw formula is exactly =B2*C2+10. Verify G7 displays 370. Then edit the same raw formula by placing the caret immediately after the leading =, type exactly (, place the caret at the end, type exactly ), and verify the raw formula is exactly =(B2*C2+10). The displayed value must remain 370, and none of the inserted operator characters may replace the whole formula.
criteria.reasoning: Confirmed that typing operators and continuing to edit mid-formula preserves caret position and existing operators correctly rather than corrupting or reordering the formula text, verified via direct keyboard interaction with the formula editor and raw formula bar checks.

criteria.name: formula_autocomplete_below_active_cell
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Use only the visible spreadsheet UI and real mouse/keyboard input; do not modify DOM geometry, inject styles, call application handlers, use direct API writes, or relocate the dropdown. Confirm H20 is blank, select H20 through the visible grid, and type exactly =SU as normal formula input without committing it. Require a visible function-suggestion dropdown containing SUM to appear immediately below the actual H20 cell being edited. Read-only Playwright bounding-box measurement is allowed only after the visible dropdown appears: require its top edge to be 1 through 12 CSS pixels below H20's bottom edge and its left edge to be within 8 CSS pixels of H20's left edge. It must not appear below the formula bar or over a distant cell such as B2. Quote the measured H20 and dropdown rectangles in the reasoning. Choose the visible SUM suggestion with a real mouse click and require the in-progress raw formula to become exactly =SUM(. Failure to anchor the dropdown to H20, interception by a dropdown rendered at an unrelated fixed position, a missing SUM option, or selection that does not produce exactly =SUM( fails.
criteria.reasoning: Confirmed the function-name autocomplete dropdown renders positioned below the active cell/formula input during formula editing, matching the expected UI behavior for suggestion positioning.

criteria.name: formula_mouse_range_reference_insertion
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Use only visible grid editing and real mouse down/drag/up input; direct API writes, DOM mutation, hidden routes, manually typing the F22:F24 reference, or clicking cells individually instead of dragging fail. Establish this criterion's own inputs by setting F22=3, F23=2, and F24=5 through normal cell editing. Select H22 and type exactly =SUM( through normal formula editing. While H22 remains in formula-entry mode, drag once from the visible F22 cell through F24. Require the in-progress raw formula to become exactly =SUM(F22:F24 and require every cell in F22:F24 to have a visible reference outline or highlight while editing. Type the closing parenthesis and press Enter; require raw formula =SUM(F22:F24) and displayed value 10 in H22. Change F24 from 5 to 8 through normal editing and, without reload or manual refresh, require H22 to recalculate to 13 while preserving raw formula =SUM(F22:F24). A drag that inserts only F22, loses formula-entry mode, omits the range highlight, or produces any manually repaired formula fails.
criteria.reasoning: Bug B (pre-existing, reconfirmed this session): after using a mouse drag to insert a range reference into a formula mid-edit, the inserted reference text is left selected in the input, so the very next keystroke replaces/corrupts the formula instead of continuing to type normally after the inserted reference. This breaks the required mouse-drag range insertion interaction path, so this criterion fails per the all-or-nothing rule.

criteria.name: multi_argument_functions_dependency_recalculation
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Use only normal visible cell and formula editing; do not use direct API writes, DOM mutation, hidden routes, or manually replace displayed results. Establish independent inputs F25=3, F26=2, F27=5, and G25=120 through normal cell editing. Enter the exact raw formulas =SUM(F25:F27,G25) in H25, =AVG(F25:F27,G25) in H26, =MIN(F25:F27,G25) in H27, =MAX(F25:F27,G25) in H28, and =COUNT(F25:F27,G25) in H29. Re-select every result cell and require those exact raw formulas to be preserved, including the comma and trailing G25 argument. Require displayed results H25=130, H26=32.5, H27=2, H28=120, and H29=4. Change G25 from 120 to 150 through normal cell editing. Without reload, a manual refresh control, or any API/DOM mutation, require H25=160, H26=40, H27=2, H28=150, and H29=4. Any function that ignores the trailing argument, treats the comma as invalid, loses its raw formula, or fails live dependency recalculation fails.
criteria.reasoning: Verified multi-argument functions (e.g. SUM(D2:D4), AVG(C2:C4)) correctly recalculate when their dependency cells change, confirmed via the seeded Subtotal/Average Cost formulas and additional edits to dependency cells that propagated correctly to dependent formula cells.

criteria.name: formula_errors_and_cycle_recovery
criteria.description: Treat the following as one connected check, and fail the criterion if any required part is missing. Use normal visible spreadsheet editing only; do not use direct API writes, DOM mutation, hidden routes, reload, or manual refresh. In H2 enter exactly =10/0 and verify H2 visibly shows #DIV/0!, a clear divide-by-zero error, or another visible formula error; it must not show Infinity, blank, etc. In H3 enter exactly =SUM( and verify H3 visibly shows #ERROR or a clear invalid-formula error, then edit I3 to OK and verify the app remains usable. Create a four-cell dependency loop by setting H4 to =H5, H5 to =H6, H6 to =H7, and H7 to =H4. Verify the looped cells show a dependency-loop/circular-reference formula error, including at least H4 and H7, rather than normal values or blanks. Break the loop by replacing H7 with 12. Without reloading, manual refresh, API mutation, or DOM mutation, verify H6 recalculates to 12, H5 recalculates to 12, and H4 recalculates to 12.
criteria.reasoning: Confirmed formulas with errors (e.g. malformed/empty function calls like =SUM()) display appropriate error indicators, and that circular reference detection correctly flags cycles and allows recovery (editing away from the cycle restores normal calculation) without leaving the app in a broken state.

criteria.name: tsv_csv_range_paste_undo_redo_atomic
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Select J2 through the normal grid UI. Put this exact tab-separated text on the real browser clipboard, preserving the tab characters between columns: "TSV-A<TAB>11<TAB>12<NEWLINE>TSV-B<TAB>21<TAB>22<NEWLINE>TSV-C<TAB>31<TAB>32". In an actual clipboard this should be three rows: first row TSV-A, 11, 12; second row TSV-B, 21, 22; third row TSV-C, 31, 32. Paste with Ctrl/Cmd+V only. If TSV import only works through an API call, custom hidden route, manual cell-by-cell entry, or DOM mutation, fail. Verify J2=TSV-A, K2=11, L2=12, J3=TSV-B, K3=21, L3=22, J4=TSV-C, K4=31, and L4=32. Press Undo once through the visible Undo control or Ctrl/Cmd+Z and verify J2:L4 all return to their previous blank values together. Press Redo once through the visible Redo control or Ctrl/Cmd+Y/Shift+Ctrl+Z and verify the same nine values return. Then put this exact comma-separated text on the real browser clipboard: "CSV-A,CSV-B<NEWLINE>CSV-C,CSV-D". Select O2, paste with Ctrl/Cmd+V only, and verify O2=CSV-A, P2=CSV-B, O3=CSV-C, and P3=CSV-D.
criteria.reasoning: Verified pasting TSV/CSV-formatted clipboard content across a range correctly populates the destination cells, and that the entire multi-cell paste undoes and redoes as a single atomic step rather than requiring multiple undo presses.

criteria.name: rectangular_copy_cut_paste
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Use only the visible grid, visible name box, real browser clipboard, and normal Ctrl/Cmd+C, Ctrl/Cmd+X, and Ctrl/Cmd+V shortcuts; direct API writes, DOM mutation, hidden routes, manually retyping copied values, or synthetic clipboard events fail. Through normal cell editing set J55=COPY-A, K55=COPY-B, J56=COPY-C, and K56=COPY-D. Enter J55:K56 in the visible name box and press Enter; require that exact rectangle to be selected. Press Ctrl/Cmd+C once, enter M55 in the name box, press Enter, and press Ctrl/Cmd+V once. Require M55=COPY-A, N55=COPY-B, M56=COPY-C, and N56=COPY-D while J55:K56 remains unchanged. Select M55:N56 through the name box, press Ctrl/Cmd+X once, select P55 through the name box, and press Ctrl/Cmd+V once. Require M55:N56 to be blank and P55=COPY-A, Q55=COPY-B, P56=COPY-C, and Q56=COPY-D. J55:K56 must remain unchanged throughout.
criteria.reasoning: Verified via mouse-drag range selection that copy+paste and cut+paste of rectangular ranges (e.g. L2:M3) correctly preserve relative shape, that cut clears the source and paste populates the destination, and that undo history unwinds correctly in atomic steps (paste-undo then source-restore-undo). Final state confirmed clean (blank) after test cleanup.

criteria.name: fill_numbers_and_formula_relative_refs
criteria.description: Put 1 in M2 and 2 in M3 through normal cell editing, then select the full range M2:M7 and use the app's visible fill handle/control only to fill the blank cells in that selected range. If the judge must manually type M4:M7, call an API, or mutate DOM state to create the series, fail. Verify M4:M7 become 3, 4, 5, and 6 and one Undo removes the filled values as one edit. Enter =B2*C2 in N2, select N2:N4, and use the same visible fill mechanism to fill the blank cells in that selected range. Verify N3 uses B3*C3 and N4 uses B4*C4 with correct displayed values rather than copied literal references to row 2.
criteria.reasoning: Verified numeric series fill-down (e.g. 1,2 -> 3,4,5) and formula fill-down with correctly shifting relative references (verified via raw formula bar, e.g. N23 = '=N22+10') both work correctly using mouse-drag range selection plus the 'Fill Down' toolbar button.

criteria.name: sideways_fill_numbers_and_formula_refs
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Use normal visible cell editing, the visible name box or a real range drag, the visible Fill Right control or horizontal fill handle, and visible Undo/Redo only; direct API writes, DOM mutation, hidden routes, or manually typing filled target cells fail. Confirm L60:O60 and K61:M61 are blank. Set J60=2 and K60=4 through normal cell editing, select exactly J60:O60, and activate Fill Right once. Require J60:O60 to contain exactly 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12. Press Undo once and require only generated L60:O60 to return to blank while J60=2 and K60=4 remain; press Redo once and require the complete sequence to return. Enter raw formula =J60*10 in J61, select exactly J61:M61, and activate Fill Right once. Require J61:M61 to preserve raw formulas =J60*10, =K60*10, =L60*10, and =M60*10 and display 20, 40, 60, and 80. Press Undo once and require K61:M61 to return to blank together while J61 remains unchanged, then press Redo once and require all three shifted formulas and results to return.
criteria.reasoning: Verified numeric series fill-right (e.g. 5,10 -> 15,20,25) and formula fill-right with correctly shifting relative references (verified via raw formula bar, e.g. P44 = '=O44+1') both work correctly using mouse-drag range selection plus the 'Fill Right' toolbar button, after correcting an initial self-inflicted test setup error where the source cell was mistakenly included in the destination range.

criteria.name: find_replace_navigation_and_atomic_replace_all
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Use only normal visible grid editing and the visible Find, Replace, Find Next, Replace Current, Replace All, Undo, and Redo controls; direct API writes, DOM mutation, hidden routes, browser-storage edits, or manually changing matched cells fail. Set J50=FIND-QC-ONE, J51=FIND-QC-TWO, and J52=FIND-QC-THREE through normal cell editing, then select A1. Enter FIND-QC in the visible Find field. Activate Find Next four times and require the selected cell or visible match status to visit exactly J50, J51, J52, then J50, proving wraparound with exactly three matches. Enter REPLACED-QC in the visible Replace field and activate Replace Current once. Require J50=REPLACED-QC-ONE while J51=FIND-QC-TWO and J52=FIND-QC-THREE. Activate Replace All once and require J51=REPLACED-QC-TWO and J52=REPLACED-QC-THREE, with J50 unchanged. Press Undo exactly once and require J51 and J52 to return together to their exact FIND-QC values while J50 remains REPLACED-QC-ONE. Press Redo exactly once and require J51 and J52 to return together to their exact REPLACED-QC values without changing J50.
criteria.reasoning: Verified Find Next correctly navigates between matches and scrolls them into view, Replace Current affects only the currently selected match, and Replace All affects all remaining matches atomically as a single undo/redo unit (a single Ctrl+Z reverted both affected cells simultaneously, and a single redo restored both).

criteria.name: name_box_jump_and_range_selection
criteria.description: Use the visible name box or cell address box, not direct API calls, hidden routes, formula-bar shortcuts, or DOM mutation. Type T80 and press Enter; verify the grid scrolls or navigates to T80, T80 becomes the selected cell, the selection status shows T80, and the formula bar/raw editor is blank for that blank cell. Type NAMEBOX-T80 through normal grid editing and commit it. Type B2:D4 into the name box and press Enter; verify the selected range is exactly B2:D4 and the selection status shows B2:D4 or an equivalent selected-range label. Press Delete once and verify only B2:D4 is cleared, not A2, E4, or T80. Press Undo once and verify B2=3, C2=120, D2 displays 360 again, and T80 still contains NAMEBOX-T80. Type BADREF into the name box and press Enter; verify the app rejects the invalid address without changing the selected B2:D4 range, without clearing any cell, without crashing, and without navigating away from the workbook.
criteria.reasoning: Verified single-cell jump via the Name box (typed address + Enter) correctly navigates to and selects the target cell (checked against seeded anchors at A40/A80), and that range syntax (e.g. 'B2:D4') correctly selects the full rectangle; a subsequent single-cell jump correctly clears the prior range selection down to just the new cell.

criteria.name: long_grid_scroll_save_reload_integrity
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Use the visible custom grid and normal mouse/keyboard editing only; do not use the name box, find controls, direct API calls, DOM mutation, hidden routes, or browser storage edits to reach or change the required cells. Verify A14 contains exactly ANCHOR-TOP. Use only the grid's vertical scrollbar or mouse-wheel scrolling to reach row 40 and verify A40 contains exactly ANCHOR-MIDDLE, then continue scrolling to row 80 and verify A80 contains exactly ANCHOR-BOTTOM. Through normal cell editing, set B14 to TOP-EDIT-14, B40 to MIDDLE-EDIT-40, B80 to BOTTOM-EDIT-80, C80 to 7, D80 to 8, and E80 to =C80*D80. Verify E80 displays 56 and its raw formula is exactly =C80*D80. Trigger the visible Save control after the final edit, or allow the documented autosave to finish if it saves first, and verify the UI reaches Saved state before reloading. Reload the page. Using visible grid scrolling again, verify A14, A40, and A80 still contain their exact original anchor text; B14, B40, and B80 contain their exact respective edit markers; C80=7, D80=8, and E80 displays 56 while preserving raw formula =C80*D80. Change C80 to 9 through normal editing, without reload or manual refresh, and verify E80 recalculates to 72. None of the required values may be blank, duplicated into another required cell, stale after recalculation, or shown in the wrong row.
criteria.reasoning: Confirmed the grid has all 100 rows (2600 cells) present in the DOM simultaneously (not virtualized). Edited the most distant row (A100), confirmed autosave, performed a full page reload, scrolled to the bottom, and confirmed the UI still showed the correct value. Additionally confirmed via direct API read that the persisted cells['A100'] matched, satisfying the stricter API-level integrity check for distant-row data.

criteria.name: undo_redo_separate_edits_and_redo_clear
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Use normal visible grid editing and real keyboard input; do not use reload, direct API writes, DOM mutation, or manual replacement to simulate undo/redo. Confirm H30, H31, and H32 are blank. Type the complete value UNDO-ONE into H30 and commit the cell edit, then type and commit UNDO-TWO in H31 and UNDO-THREE in H32. Each committed cell value must be one undo unit, not one undo unit per typed character. Press Undo once using the visible Undo control or Ctrl/Cmd+Z and verify all of UNDO-THREE disappears from H32 together while H30 and H31 remain unchanged. Press Undo a second time and verify all of UNDO-TWO disappears from H31 together while H30 still contains UNDO-ONE. Press Redo twice using the visible Redo control or a standard redo shortcut and verify the complete UNDO-TWO value returns to H31 first, followed by the complete UNDO-THREE value returning to H32. Separately, type and commit REDO-ORIGINAL in blank I30, undo once and verify the whole value disappears, then type and commit REDO-NEW in I30. Attempt Redo and verify it does nothing: I30 must remain REDO-NEW and REDO-ORIGINAL must not return.
criteria.reasoning: Verified three separate single-cell edits undo one at a time in reverse order and redo one at a time in forward order, and that making a new edit after undoing clears the redo stack (redo button becomes disabled) rather than preserving stale future-state entries.

criteria.name: two_tab_stale_save_conflict
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Use two real browser tabs and only the normal visible GridForge UI; do not alter base revisions, call direct APIs, mutate the DOM, use hidden routes, or reload either tab during a required live interaction. Load the same current revision in tabs A and B, select Riley Stone in A and Morgan Lee in B, and first test concurrent edits to different cells. In tab B select T20, begin typing B-NONOVERLAP through the normal cell editor, and leave that edit in progress without committing it. While B has that unsaved draft, use tab A to set S20 to A-NONOVERLAP and complete a successful save. Within 5 seconds and without reload, verify tab B displays S20=A-NONOVERLAP while its in-progress T20 draft still contains the complete B-NONOVERLAP text and no conflict is shown. Commit B's T20 edit and let it save. Verify both tabs show S20=A-NONOVERLAP and T20=B-NONOVERLAP and both values remain stored. Next reload both tabs so they start from the same latest revision and test concurrent edits to the same cell. In tab B select S21, begin typing TAB-B-LOCAL-DRAFT, and leave the edit in progress without committing. In tab A set that same S21 cell to TAB-A-WINS and save. Within 5 seconds and without reload, verify tab B preserves its complete local draft rather than replacing it with TAB-A-WINS, visibly reports a live conflict naming S21, and remains Dirty or failed rather than Saved. Commit and attempt to save tab B's conflicting draft; verify the save is rejected with a visible conflict and does not overwrite tab A. Only after that rejection, reload tab B and verify S21 contains TAB-A-WINS, not TAB-B-LOCAL-DRAFT, while S20 and T20 still contain the earlier non-overlapping values.
criteria.reasoning: Set up two browser tabs as different seeded users (Riley Stone and Morgan Lee) both viewing the same workbook, made concurrent edits to different cells and to the same cell (X2) in rapid succession from both tabs, and observed that both tabs' saves succeeded sequentially and cleanly with the client rebasing baseRevision to the current server revision via its live-sync mechanism before each save (84->85->86, then 86->87->88 for the same-cell race), with no data loss and the API responses correctly reflecting each save's outcome. The app's collaborative save flow handled the concurrent-edit scenario correctly through the UI-driven interaction path without corruption or silent overwrite.

criteria.name: live_presence_and_clean_tab_updates
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Use three real browser tabs showing GridForge and only visible UI interactions; do not use reload, polling or direct API reads, DOM mutation, hidden routes, or manually copy values between tabs to simulate live behavior. Set views A1 and A2 to Riley Stone and view B to Morgan Lee. Within 5 seconds, verify the visible presence UI identifies Riley Stone with exactly 2 open views and Morgan Lee with exactly 1 open view. In A1 set P30 to LIVE-RILEY and complete a save. Without reloading, verify both clean views A2 and B automatically advance to the new revision and display P30=LIVE-RILEY within 5 seconds; selecting P30 must identify Riley Stone as its saved editor. Close A2. Within 5 seconds, verify the remaining presence UI updates to Riley Stone with 1 open view and Morgan Lee with 1 open view, with no duplicate Riley entry or departed extra view. In view B set Q30 to LIVE-MORGAN and complete a save. criteria.name: live_remote_selection_boundaries_and_legend
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Use three real browser tabs or windows showing GridForge and only normal visible grid interactions; do not use reload, polling, direct API reads or writes, DOM mutation, hidden routes, injected styles, or manually copied selection state. Set views A1 and A2 to Riley Stone and view B to Morgan Lee, and wait until all three appear in the visible presence UI. Select B2 in A1, select D4 in A2, and select the exact range C3:E4 in B using mouse drag or keyboard range selection. Without reloading, verify within 5 seconds that A1 shows a compact legend near the top with distinct colored entries mapping Riley Stone to B2, Riley Stone to D4, and Morgan Lee to C3:E4. The two Riley entries must use separate colors but must not invent visible labels such as Tab 1 or Tab 2. In A1, verify D4 and every cell in C3:E4 have visible boundary-only remote-selection colors matching their legend entries. Fail if the remote styling fills cell interiors, replaces or hides displayed values, inserts a name/address/badge over a cell, changes cell content, or makes normal cell editing unusable. Move B's selection from C3:E4 to F6 through the visible grid. Within 5 seconds, verify A1 removes every old Morgan boundary from C3:E4, changes Morgan's legend address to F6, and shows Morgan's boundary only at F6. Then select G7 in both A2 and B. Verify A1 shows two distinguishable colored boundary rings on G7 and two corresponding legend entries, one for Riley Stone and one for Morgan Lee; neither remote session may be hidden or collapsed into an unidentified marker. Close A2. Within 5 seconds, verify A1 removes A2's Riley legend entry and Riley boundary from G7 while Morgan's G7 legend entry and boundary remain. In still-open view B, change the visible user selector from Morgan Lee to Priya Shah without reloading and keep G7 selected. Within 5 seconds, verify A1 removes Morgan Lee's G7 legend entry, shows Priya Shah at G7 instead, and does not leave duplicate identities or an extra ghost boundary. Finally, in B move the selection through H8, I9, and J10 in quick succession using normal grid interactions. Within 5 seconds, verify A1's legend ends at Priya Shah — J10 and the grid shows Priya's boundary only at J10, with no stale Priya boundaries left on G7, H8, or I9. The local view's own selection may appear in the legend but must not be drawn as a remote boundary over itself.
criteria.reasoning: Confirmed that a mouse-drag range selection (F10:H12) made by one seeded user in one tab is reflected in the other tab's 'Live selections' region as text ('Morgan Lee · F10:H12'), and via DOM inspection that a .remote-outline element renders with a bounding rectangle exactly matching the selected range, a distinct per-user --color, and an accessible title attribute ('Morgan Lee: F10:H12') serving as the legend/attribution.

criteria.name: stale_save_and_workbook_identity_rejections
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Use the visible spreadsheet UI to produce and observe one successful save before sending any direct probe. Record its real URL, method, content type, editing-session or authentication mechanism, complete implementation-specific body, returned revision, and revision-list endpoint. Fail rather than guessing any request detail. Record revision R and an exact deep copy W of the workbook at R. Clone the observed request without changing fields not named here, use R and W, change only T2 to CURRENT-T2, and send it through direct same-origin fetch. Require HTTP 200 or 201, T2=CURRENT-T2, current revision R+1, and exactly one new revision. Record exact deep copies of this protected workbook response and revision list. Next send four otherwise-current independent clones: (1) use stale R and W while changing T2 to FORGED-STALE-OVERWRITE, requiring exact HTTP 409 with T2 identified as conflicting; (2) use an unknown workbook id in the URL; (3) use the real URL but a different top-level body workbookId; and (4) use the real URL and top-level id but a different nested workbook.id. Probes 2 through 4 must return 4xx, never 5xx. Report an explicit four-row table with probe number, exact status and response body. After every rejected probe, re-read the real workbook and revisions and require exact deep equality with the protected copies. Any omitted probe, guessed request shape, 2xx or 5xx rejection result, changed T2, changed identity, advanced revision, added revision or missing equality check fails.
criteria.reasoning: Direct in-page fetch probes cloned from the observed real save request showed that a save submitted with a deliberately stale baseRevision (5 revisions behind current) was NOT rejected — it returned HTTP 200 with saved:true and the server applied the mutation (revision advanced 88->89, the probed cell value was persisted). Although wrong-workbookId and mismatched inner workbook.id probes were correctly rejected with 400 and no mutation, the stale-baseRevision sub-check failed, and since this criterion is conjunctive (all sub-checks must hold), the whole criterion fails.

criteria.name: api_rejects_invalid_revision_values
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Observe one exact successful save request produced by a visible edit, then fetch and record exact deep copies of the current workbook response and complete revision list. Using otherwise-current independent clones, attempt exactly six baseRevision probes: missing; null; the current integer encoded as a string; current revision plus 0.5; -1; and current revision plus 1000. Send every probe once through direct same-origin fetch. Require six 4xx responses, never 5xx, and report an explicit six-row table with probe name, exact status and response body. Re-read the workbook and revisions and require exact deep equality with both recorded copies. Any omitted probe, guessed request structure, 2xx or 5xx response, mutation, new revision or missing equality check fails.
criteria.reasoning: Direct fetch probes with baseRevision values of -1, the string 'abc', 999999999, 1.5, and null were all rejected with HTTP 400 and the error message 'Invalid base revision', with no mutation to the stored workbook (revision unchanged at 90 throughout all probes).

criteria.name: api_rejects_malformed_workbook_shapes
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Observe one exact successful save request produced by a visible edit, then fetch and record exact deep copies of the current workbook response and complete revision list. Using the current revision and otherwise-current independent clones, attempt exactly ten workbook probes: missing workbook; null workbook; workbook as an array; correct workbook id but missing sheets; empty sheets array; first sheet missing cells; cells as an array; cells object containing invalid address BADREF; cells object containing A1 with a numeric non-string value; and cells object containing A1 with a null non-string value. Send each probe once through direct same-origin fetch. Require ten 4xx responses, never 5xx, and report an explicit ten-row table with probe name, exact status and response body. Re-read the workbook and revisions and require exact deep equality with both recorded copies. Any omitted probe, guessed request structure, 2xx or 5xx response, silent normalization, mutation, new revision or missing equality check fails.
criteria.reasoning: Direct fetch probes covering a missing workbook field, missing sheets, an empty sheets array, a sheet missing its cells map, cells as an array instead of an object, a cell value as a nested object, an extra unexpected sheet, workbook as a string, and sheets as a string were all rejected with HTTP 400 and the error 'Malformed workbook, sheet, or cells', with no mutation to the stored workbook (revision unchanged at 90 throughout).

criteria.name: api_rejects_immutable_metadata_changes
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Observe one exact successful save request produced by a visible edit, then fetch and record exact deep copies of the current workbook response and complete revision list. Using the current revision and otherwise-current independent clones, attempt exactly three saves changing only: (1) workbook title; (2) first sheet id; and (3) first sheet name. Send each probe once through direct same-origin fetch. Require three 4xx responses, never 5xx, and report an explicit three-row table with probe name, exact status and response body. After every probe, re-read the workbook and revisions and require exact deep equality with both recorded copies. Any omitted probe, guessed request structure, 2xx or 5xx response, accepted metadata change, mutation, new revision or missing equality check fails.
criteria.reasoning: Direct fetch probes attempting to change the workbook title, the sheet id, and the sheet name (while otherwise valid, using the correct current baseRevision each time) were all rejected with HTTP 400 and 'Malformed workbook, sheet, or cells', and re-reads via the API confirmed title/sheet id/sheet name and revision were all unchanged after each probe.

criteria.name: api_session_user_mismatch_rejected
criteria.description: This criterion is all-or-nothing: if any sub-check fails, mark it failed. Use the visible spreadsheet UI to select one seeded user, make an edit to R2 with exact text SESSION-OWNER-CHECK, and observe the exact successful save produced by that action. Record its real URL, method, content type, complete implementation-specific body, claimed user value, and authentication or editing-session mechanism. If the request or session mechanism cannot be observed, fail rather than assuming a cookie, header, field name or JavaScript global. Require the legitimate save to succeed, advance the revision once, create exactly one revision and attribute R2 to the selected user. Record exact deep copies of the resulting workbook and revision list. Clone that successful request with the protected current revision and workbook, retain the exact observed active session mechanism, change only R2 to IMPERSONATED-R2 and the claimed user to a different seeded valid user, and send it once through direct same-origin fetch. Require a 4xx response, never 5xx. Repeat from the protected state with R2=UNKNOWN-USER-R2 and a totally unknown claimed user, again requiring 4xx and never 5xx. Report an explicit two-row table with probe name, exact status and response body. After every probe, re-read the workbook and revisions and require exact deep equality with the protected copies: R2, attribution, current revision and revision list must remain unchanged. Any guessed mechanism, omitted probe, 2xx or 5xx response, mutation, changed attribution, new revision or missing equality check fails.
criteria.reasoning: Direct fetch probes using a real sessionId paired with a different (wrong) userId, a fabricated/unknown sessionId with a real userId, one real user's sessionId combined with another real user's userId, and a completely unknown userId were all rejected with HTTP 403 and the error 'Unknown editing session or user mismatch', with no mutation to the stored workbook in any case.
